# GrantGunner: find and track EU and UK grants for startups on autopilot

GrantGunner is an AI-powered grant discovery and application platform. Your agent finds funding opportunities-including grants, fellowships, competitions, accelerators, prizes, and relevant investor programmes-then applies on your behalf in full autopilot or with your approval before each submission.

Built for startups, charities, researchers, and social enterprises. GrantGunner handles complex application forms, keeps an opportunity calendar so you never miss a deadline, and lets you schedule submissions. Switch between full autopilot and assisted mode whenever you like.

Use GrantGunner to search continuously for suitable calls, match opportunities to your organisation profile, draft and submit applications, and track pipelines from discovery through to award or feedback-all from one place.

Everyone's using AI to draft. We help you use it smarter - and stay in control when it matters.

data.summary: GrantGunner is an AI-driven platform designed to help startups, charities, researchers, and social enterprises discover and apply for various funding opportunities, including grants and fellowships. It automates multiple aspects of the application process, allowing users to either apply on autopilot or maintain control by reviewing applications before submission. Key features include an opportunity calendar to track deadlines, browser extensions for drafting applications directly on funders' websites, and the ability to match applications with organizational profiles.
